methodology: Built from 12 of 13 listed 'Statistical bulletin' documents (1 skipped). Million KZT, STATE budget (republican plus local), YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE -- resets each January, so a January value is not a collapse from the previous December. Read from column 5 of sheet 'табл 3'; the existing annual series of the same name reads column 3 of the same sheet. Deficit (negative) or surplus (positive), -2,275,950 mln KZT for January-June 2026. Every fetch re-checks the budget identity against the latest bulletin: revenue - expenditure - net lending - balance on financial-asset operations must equal this line, and all five are published independently on the sheet.
